import copy
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(w):
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        segs=[]; j=0
        while j<h:
            if col[j]:
                cc=col[j]; s=j
                while j<h and col[j]==cc: j+=1
                segs.append((cc,s,j-s))
            else: j+=1
        for cc,s,L in segs:
            up=s-L-1
            lo=s
            # extend up while empty and no horizontal row
            rr=up
            while rr>=0 and g[rr][c]==0 and rr not in {r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r])>1}:
                o[rr][c]=cc; rr-=1
            # extend down similarly
            rr=s+L+1
            while rr<h and g[rr][c]==0 and rr not in {r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r])>1}:
                o[rr][c]=cc; rr+=1
    return o

def segs_along(line):
    n=len(line); out=[]; j=0
    while j<n:
        if line[j]:
            c=line[j]; s=j
            while j<n and line[j]==c: j+=1
            out.append((c,s,j-s))
